mode: retrospective chronological research; all historical intervals were previously accessible and viewed

rules.family: all 30 existing and proposed factors, primary horizon only
rules.development: positive mean Rank IC and positive mean top-minus-bottom gross return
rules.validation: positive mean Rank IC, positive spread, factor coverage >= 0.8, label coverage >= 0.95, one-sided normal HAC p adjusted with Benjamini-Yekutieli <= 0.1
rules.order: descending validation HAC lower bound, then mean Rank IC, then identifier
rules.correlation_period: validation only; average same-day Spearman on common eligible stocks
rules.fallback: if no new candidate passes, select none; retain the fixed baseline backtests
